notes: Found by rule b, MODERATE: three opened reports all start at Mineral King (1998/355 Mineral King, SAW TIMBER TRAIL waypoint; 2026 wacziarg Mineral King, returned to Sawtooth Pass TH; 2008/1655 Sawtooth Pass TH but only an attempt, weak). trailhead.name: Meysan Lake Trailhead (off Whitney Portal road), Inyo NF

identifiedBy.fact: Meysan Lake trail from Whitney Portal; LeConte then traverse to North Notch and Corcoran. Same start in climber.org 2007/1609 (Whitney Portal), 2001/782 (camp at Meysan Lake), 1997/229 (from spring north of Meysan Lake)

otherFacts.value: Howard S. Gates, 1933
easiest route class 2-3 (Secor)
Meysan Lake trail about 5 mi, 3600 ft gain, ~4 hr
up LeConte, traverse eight gullies to gully 7 / North Notch, then gully 8, ~200 ft to summit; traverse under 2 h
waterfall pitch ~12 ft below LeConte NW chute; handline or body rappel

notes: Found by rule b, MODERATE. Of 6 climber.org reports opened, 4 use Meysan Lakes from the Whitney Portal side (2009/1710 and 2007/1609 name Meysan Lake TH / Whitney Portal; 2001/782 and 1997/229 say Meysan Lake only, trailhead inferred). 2 use other starts: 2001/783 Cottonwood (Horseshoe Meadow) via New Army Pass, Iridescent Lake; 2002/965 Tuttle Creek TH (which reaches LeConte/Corcoran North Notch but skipped Corcoran). 2001/783 author itself suggests Meysan as an alternative; none calls another start usual. Meysan Lake TH and Whitney Portal lot are ~0.9 km apart; the trail starts at the Meysan Lake TH signed point, parking is at Whitney Portal. Wikipedia names no trailhead. SummitPost 403.
